title: Crash investigations with USAF/CIA involvement in Virginia and Brazil
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Crash investigations with USAF/CIA involvement in Virginia and Brazil, about unspecified at United States (no place named), and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And then and then it's so that the crashes were then, you know, if if there's US Air Force and CIA involvement which like that they're always seems to be as in the case of Virginia even in Brazil.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that when unexplained craft crash, the US Air Force and the CIA, the American spy agency, always seem to be involved in looking into them. He points to cases in Virginia and in Brazil as examples, without giving dates. If true, it would suggest a quiet, repeated pattern of US agencies handling crashes, even in other countries.
